item.content:encoded:
Everyday Greetings (ការស្វាគមន៍ប្រចាំថ្ងៃ)

Essential English lines for everyday conversations: meet and greet, introductions, polite questions and warm goodbyes. Includes native audio and Khmer meanings.

At a glance · មើលមួយភ្លែត

Starting a conversation in English is simple: smile, greet warmly, state your name, and ask how the other person is doing.

  • Hello: Start with a warm greeting
  • My name is...: Introduce yourself clearly
  • Nice to meet you: Polite expression of goodwill
  • See you soon: End the chat warmly

Text

Greetings · ការស្វាគមន៍
Good morning! How are you doing today? I am doing well, thank you. And you?
💡 Meaning: A polite morning greeting asking how someone is feeling or doing. 🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ អរុណសួស្តី! តើអ្នកសុខសប្បាយជាទេថ្ងៃនេះ? 💡 Meaning: A positive response showing gratitude and asking back about the other person. 🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ ខ្ញុំសុខសប្បាយធម្មតាទេ អរគុណច្រើន។ ចុះអ្នកវិញ?

Introductions · ការណែនាំខ្លួន
My name is Vuthchan. It is nice to meet you. I am from Cambodia. Where are you from?
💡 Meaning: Used to state your name and express pleasure in meeting someone for the first time. 🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ ខ្ញុំឈ្មោះ វុឌ្ឍច័ន្ទ។ រីករាយណាស់ដែលបានស្គាល់អ្នក។ 💡 Meaning: Tells your country of origin and asks about the other person's hometown or country. 🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ ខ្ញុំមកពីប្រទេសកម្ពុជា។ តើអ្នកមកពីណាដែរ?

Small Talk · ការសន្ទនាទូទៅ
How has your day been so far? Could you please help me with this?
💡 Meaning: A friendly small-talk question asking about someone's activities and mood today. 🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ តើថ្ងៃនេះអ្នកយ៉ាងម៉េចដែរ? 💡 Meaning: A polite request asking someone for assistance or guidance on a task. 🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ តើអ្នកអាចជួយខ្ញុំបន្តិចបានទេ?

Goodbyes · ការលាគ្នា
I have to get going now. It was great talking to you. Have a wonderful day and see you later!
💡 Meaning: A polite way to end a conversation when you need to leave. 🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ ខ្ញុំត្រូវទៅឥឡូវនេះហើយ។ រីករាយណាស់ដែលបានជជែកជាមួយអ្នក។ 💡 Meaning: A warm farewell wishing someone well until the next time you meet. 🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ សូមឱ្យមានថ្ងៃដ៏ល្អ ហើយជួបគ្នាពេលក្រោយ!

Q&A

Common Questions · សំណួរដែលតែងជួបញឹកញាប់

Q. How should I respond to 'How are you?' (តើខ្ញុំគួរឆ្លើយតបយ៉ាងដូចម្តេចចំពោះសំណួរ 'How are you?')
A. A natural reply is 'I am doing well, thank you! How about you?' rather than only saying 'I am fine'. (💡 English: Saying 'I am doing well' and asking back shows genuine courtesy. 🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ ចម្លើយបែបធម្មជាតិគឺ 'I am doing well, thank you! How about you?' ជាជាងឆ្លើយតែមួយម៉ាត់ 'I am fine'។)

Everyday Questions · សំណួរទូទៅ

Q. How do I tell someone what I do? (តើខ្ញុំគួរប្រាប់គេអំពីការងារ ឬការរៀនសូត្ររបស់ខ្ញុំយ៉ាងដូចម្តេច?)
A. You can say 'I work in technology' or 'I am learning English right now'. (💡 English: Use 'I work in [field]' or 'I am learning [subject]'. 🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ អ្នកអាចនិយាយថា 'I work in technology' ឬ 'I am learning English right now'។)

Survival Lines · ឃ្លាពេលស្តាប់មិនទាន់

Could you please speak a little slower? (💡 English: Requesting the speaker to reduce speed · 🇰🇭 តើអ្នកអាចជួយនិយាយយឺតៗបន្តិចបានទេ?)

Sorry, could you repeat that again? (💡 English: Asking someone to repeat what was just said · 🇰🇭 សុំទោស តើអ្នកអាចជួយនិយាយម្តងទៀតបានទេ?)

Vocabulary (12)

Greetings · ការស្វាគមន៍
Hello: 💡 Used as a greeting when meeting someone · 🇰🇭 សួស្តី
Good morning: 💡 Polite greeting used from early morning until noon · 🇰🇭 អរុណសួស្តី
Good afternoon: 💡 Greeting used from noon until late afternoon · 🇰🇭 ទិវាសួស្តី (ពេលរសៀល)
Nice to meet you: 💡 Polite expression when meeting someone for the first time · 🇰🇭 រីករាយដែលបានស្គាល់

Everyday Phrases · ឃ្លាប្រចាំថ្ងៃ
Thank you: 💡 Expression of appreciation and gratitude · 🇰🇭 អរគុណ
You are welcome: 💡 Polite response when someone thanks you · 🇰🇭 មិនអីទេ / ដោយក្តីរីករាយ
Excuse me: 💡 Used to politely get attention or apologize briefly · 🇰🇭 សុំទោស / សុំការអនុញ្ញាត
Please: 💡 Polite word used when making a request · 🇰🇭 សូម / មេត្តា

Parting Words · ពាក្យលាគ្នា
Goodbye: 💡 Expression used when parting or leaving someone · 🇰🇭 លាហើយ
See you soon: 💡 Friendly farewell expecting to meet again soon · 🇰🇭 ជួបគ្នាឆាប់ៗ
Take care: 💡 Caring expression wishing safety and health · 🇰🇭 ថែរក្សាខ្លួន
Have a nice day: 💡 Polite wish for someone to enjoy the rest of their day · 🇰🇭 សូមឱ្យមានថ្ងៃល្អ
